meta.name: muapi-ad-creative
meta.description: Generate a high-converting ad creative set — hero image, ad copy variations, and platform-optimized crops for Meta, Google Display, and LinkedIn.

copy.tagline: 生成多平台广告创意素材，提升转化效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速制作高转化率的广告图片和文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-converting ad creatives for multiple platforms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce ad images and copy that drive conversions

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 生成广告创意素材：先创建一张主视觉图和三条文案变体，等你选定文案后，再自动裁剪出适配 Meta、Google Display、LinkedIn 的多种尺寸图片。
howto.when: 当你提到“广告创意”、“Facebook 广告”、“Google 广告”等关键词，或要求制作广告素材时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一套 SaaS 项目管理工具的广告素材，目标受众是远程团队创始人。
say.note: 触发 Phase A，生成主图和三条文案。

say.text: 选文案 B，继续生成各平台尺寸。
say.note: 确认文案方向后进入 Phase B，输出裁剪图。

howto.what_en: Generates ad creative assets: first creates a hero image and three copy variations; after you pick a copy, automatically crops the image to multiple sizes for Meta, Google Display, and LinkedIn.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "ad creative", "Facebook ad", "Google ad", or ask to create ad materials.

say_en.text: Create an ad set for a SaaS project management tool targeting remote team founders.
say_en.note: Triggers Phase A: hero image and 3 copy variations.

say_en.text: Pick copy B and generate platform crops.
say_en.note: Confirms copy direction and starts Phase B cropping.
